evidence_kinds.base_check: whole-image bsr/literal agreement with wrong-base and byte-order controls
evidence_kinds.inventory: static disassembly (Neptune decoder and recursive descent)
evidence_kinds.reconciliation: address classification of upstream runtime leads and prior Neptune results
evidence_kinds.residency: byte identity in captured natural emulator WorkRAM-H images
evidence_kinds.upstream_comparison: second static implementation on identical bytes

limitations: Static entries are reachability or pointer hypotheses, not proof of execution or source-level functions
Tier B/C rules follow published SHC/GCC heuristics also used by upstream; upstream agreement is implementation consistency, not independent heuristic validation
Residency checks byte identity in captured images; it does not prove that any instruction executed
Master/slave CPU role, overlays loaded after these modules and other modules are not covered
BOOT bsr/literal base test has no signal (BOOT calls are almost all jsr-literal); its mapping rests on exact frame-600 residency
Unclassified halfwords and unresolved indirect sites keep the true function denominator open

base_check.rule: declared agreement >= 0.1, >= 5x every control, and strictly greatest
